results.title: ML-DSA-65 key generation matches NIST ACVP vectors
results.detail: 25 of 25 official NIST test cases produce the expected public key

results.title: A fake gateway cannot prove itself to the board
results.detail: Board refused the welcome: gateway could not prove its enrolled keys

results.title: One flipped bit is refused; the next capsule still opens
results.detail: Capsule 2 refused on its Poly1305 tag; capsule 3 opened after the ratchet skipped key 2

results.title: A recorded capsule sent again is refused
results.detail: Copy refused (replayed message: that reading's key is already gone); one reading stored

results.title: Impostor board with its own keys is refused at its first capsule
results.detail: Forged “tank 97%” refused; live session untouched

results.title: A board missing from the roster is refused before key work
results.detail: A board calling itself tank-77 is not on the ward roster. It was refused before any key work.

results.title: A recorded hello gets the attacker nothing
results.detail: 5 replays answered but none could seal a capsule; 5 refused by the handshake rate limit; live session untouched

results.title: Stolen board opens no earlier reading; re-key locks it out
results.detail: Opened 0 of 5 earlier capsules; read capsule [6] after the theft; re-key healed it

results.title: 2,400 mutated hellos and capsules: no crash, nothing forged
results.detail: 0 crashes, 0 forged capsules accepted

results.title: A sender that stalls mid-frame is dropped and blocks nobody
results.detail: Real sensor served in 0.31 s while the staller hung; the staller was dropped by the 1 s body timeout

results.title: Power cut mid-session: board reconnects at once; dead link is cleaned up
results.detail: Rebooted board served in 0.20 s; the dead connection was closed by the 1 s idle timeout

results.title: A connection that never says hello is closed
results.detail: Closed by the 0.8 s hello timeout and logged

results.title: Connection flood is capped; the gateway recovers
results.detail: 32 of 48 flood connections turned away at the cap of 16; afterwards the sensor delivered 3 readings

results.title: A frame claiming 10 MB is refused without allocating it
results.detail: Connection closed at once, nothing allocated; the gateway kept serving

results.title: Garbage in place of a hello is refused
results.detail: Both refused with an explicit reject frame

results.title: Radio outage longer than the idle timeout loses no reading
results.detail: 40 of 40 readings stored, 35 of them buffered through a 1.8 s outage and a reconnect; no gap in tank time

results.title: A reading resent after a lost receipt is stored once
results.detail: Resent copy recognised by its tank time, acknowledged again, stored once

results.title: Gateway restart keeps readings and the context the rules need
results.detail: Restored 6 readings; a 30-point jump right after the restart was still caught (SENSOR)

results.title: A full board buffer drops the oldest readings and counts them
results.detail: Buffer of 10 through a 20-reading outage: 11 oldest readings dropped and counted, the newest 14 delivered in order; every reading delivered or accounted for

results.title: A clone made from stolen keys raises the clone alarm
results.detail: Both boards proved genuine keys; the overlap raised the alarm, quarantined the tank, and marked the overlapping session's reading suspect

results.title: A revoked board's handshakes are refused
results.detail: Refused: ward-tank-01 is revoked; re-enroll it on site

results.title: Re-enrolling on site restores the board and locks out stolen keys
results.detail: New keys accepted; the old keys could not even verify the gateway, and their capsule was refused

results.title: Handshake rate limit caps a flood of hellos
results.detail: 6 handshakes answered, 3 refused within the 60 s window

results.title: A board that stops reporting is flagged, and cleared when it returns
results.detail: Flagged after 0.4 s of silence; cleared by the next reading

results.title: Six re-keys in a row raise no false clone alarm
results.detail: 6 sessions, 12 readings, no clone alarm

results.title: A frozen level sensor is detected
results.detail: SENSOR: Level sensor is stuck

results.title: No echo: level ignored, no tanker sent on it
results.detail: SENSOR: Level sensor gets no echo; no tanker sent on a blind reading

results.title: Something inside the blind zone is reported, not believed
results.detail: SENSOR: Something is inside the sensor's blind zone

results.title: Probes out of the water raise no false quality alarm
results.detail: TANKER: Send a water tanker (40 NTU in air ignored)

results.title: An impossible pH is a probe fault, not a water alarm
results.detail: pH probe fault; no false water-pH alarm

results.title: One turbidity spike waits for confirmation; two in a row act
results.detail: single 7 NTU → CHECK, two in a row → SAMPLE, 20 NTU at once → SAMPLE

results.title: Plate under the sensor: genuine capsule, impossible level
results.detail: The level reads 99%, above the overflow pipe at 98%. Water cannot stand there; something is under the sensor.

results.title: Level rising with the main closed is not believed
results.detail: Level rose 30 points in 10 min; with the main closed it can rise at most 2. Treat the level as untrusted until someone checks the sensor.

results.title: Tanker booked before the tank runs dry
results.detail: Tanker first requested at 19:20 with the tank at 46%
